text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle completed her Debut race with 
eye-opening speed. Her supporting peers 
and rivals congratulated her from the 
bottom of their hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Armed with her speed, K.S.Miracle wishes 
to take the Sprint Route. However, 
excessive speed always comes with danger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer proposes using the time until 
next spring as a preparation period. 
Though puzzled for a moment, she agrees, 
knowing it's out of concern for her.
